_comment: Taiga per-client drafter overlays. Specialty_anchors map a specialty tag (taiga_<specialty>) to the angle the drafter should lead with. The drafter consumes this when the candidate's vertical bucket matches a key.
anchors: the 50% mental-health denial baseline you posted is the headline stat — every brand misses that the 2% best-in-class denial rate IS achievable, just not with the EHR's built-in billing module
2% vs 5-10% denied claims is the cleanest single-number gap in the SMB practice market
operational fragility at solo / small practice means one billing error compounds for 90 days before anyone notices

specialty_anchors.taiga_psychiatry: Mental-health parity is the headline. Lead with 50% denial baseline; that is the post-parity test, not the baseline.
specialty_anchors.taiga_dermatology: Cash-pay aesthetic mix complicates RCM. Lead with the cash-pay-percent fragility, not a billing-tool pitch.
specialty_anchors.taiga_cardiology: Cardiology is procedure-heavy and modifier-fragile. Lead with denial-rate-by-modifier, not 'denial rate'.
specialty_anchors.taiga_oncology: Oncology is high-dollar low-volume. Lead with the $-per-claim variance and prior-auth turnaround.
specialty_anchors.taiga_internal_medicine: Internal medicine is mostly DPC / concierge / hybrid. Lead with operational fragility, not denials.
specialty_anchors.taiga_podiatry: Podiatry is tier-2 specialty under Medicare scrutiny. Lead with audit-readiness.
